## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` pass
- [ ] The course says what changed (`CLAUDE.md`, "The course")
- [ ] No data file is committed; a dataset is a recipe in `datasets/` (`CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Nothing about an identifiable person, and no individual-level human data

### If it brings a calibration

- [ ] Every changed value says where it comes from
- [ ] The data are a recipe in `datasets/`, or the reference and how access is obtained
- [ ] The method and the whole comparison are here and in the chapter, what does not fit included
- [ ] For data under restricted access: my access agreement allows sharing what this contains, and it holds aggregate results only
